symptom: after the entity run of ako/mxcli#2160, a script that builds a domain model still spent a fifth of its time in Backend.ListDomainModels: each added entity and its association listed and converted every domain model of the project ten times
cause: lookups that ask about one named module listed the project to answer. findEntity listed every domain model and filtered by module name, and CREATE ASSOCIATION calls it four times (each end once for itself, once more through projectEntityPersistence). The dispatch's name-space guard (refuseNameClash) built the project-wide set of entity names and of association names for every create, though a name is only ever looked up qualified. The conversion to the semantic model is 70% of a listing, and the decode cache of ADR-0015 does not save it
file: mdl/executor/oql_type_inference.go (findEntity, moduleDomainModel), mdl/executor/validate_name_clash.go (domainModelNameSet, refuseNameClash), mdl/backend/modelsdk/domainmodel.go (DomainModelListings counter)
insight: The profile named two callers; a counter on the listing and a temporary print of its call stacks named eight, and the per-pair count was ten where reading the handler suggested seven. Count first. The narrowed reads keep the listing as their fallback for what a single read does not answer - the virtual System module, a module spelled in another case, a module that does not exist yet, a mock backend that serves only the listing - so the 140 mock tests that stub ListDomainModels alone say nothing about the new path; the behaviour is pinned on the PedApp fixture instead, and compared against the previous binary on six refusals. A first control (exact instead of case-folded module match) passed because of that same fallback: a mutation that lands in the fallback is not a control. Making the narrowed set forget associations, and the narrowed lookup miss, each fail the test. What remains is the member-name check (CE0069), one listing per statement: it follows generalizations and owner-both associations across modules, so one module's model cannot answer it. Measured: listings per added entity and association 10 -> 2; the 300-entity seed 9.7 s -> 8.4 s on first run and 14.5 s -> 9.6 s on a settled re-run, same machine, interleaved.
